source_a_wording: Earlier design included E2 vs E3 benign B-FER non-inferiority; v2.1 summary describes Gate 2 as E2 vs E1 emergency-recall preservation. The benign false-alarm safeguard appears removed.
source_b_wording: Gate 1: Pooled Confuser A-FER Superiority (E2 vs E3); Gate 2: Benign Background B-FER Non-Inferiority (E2 vs E3, delta_B=0.020); Gate 3: Emergency Macro-Recall Non-Inferiority (E2 vs E3, delta_R=0.025); Gate 4: Full Benchmark Macro-F1 Superiority (E2 vs E3).
methodological_impact: If Gate 2 tests emergency recall against E1, benign background false alarms are never evaluated in the safety gates, allowing a model that floods benign audio with false alarms to pass. Furthermore, E1 (N=422) is not matched with E2 (N=634), confounding data volume with data strategy.
recommended_resolution: Reaffirm the 4-gate sequence in Protocol v2.1: Gate 1 (A-FER superiority vs E3), Gate 2 (B-FER non-inferiority vs E3, delta_B=0.020), Gate 3 (Emergency Macro-Recall non-inferiority vs E3, delta_R=0.025), Gate 4 (Macro-F1 superiority vs E3). Both safety gates compare against the matched E3 arm.

source_a_wording: Is pooled targeted-confuser false-emergency reduction the appropriate primary confirmatory claim? Should all seven confuser subdomains remain exploratory at N=50 each?
source_b_wording: Primary confirmatory claims rest strictly on the pooled Gatekeeper sequence (Gates 1 to 4). All individual category breakdowns (N = 50) are formally designated exploratory secondary endpoints, eliminating the risk of claiming confirmation on underpowered slices.
methodological_impact: In Phase 1 and 2, category-specific claims were made (e.g. fireworks +41.33 pp, shouting +36.00 pp). Slices of N=50 have only 25.8% to 40.6% power under multiplicity control. Treating them as confirmatory would yield high Type II error or uncorrected false discoveries.
recommended_resolution: Formally freeze pooled theta_1 (N=350) as the sole primary confirmatory estimand. All 7 category subdomains (N=50 each) must be reported with unadjusted and Holm-adjusted p-values but explicitly labeled descriptive exploratory secondary endpoints.

source_a_wording: The summary says 'Upper 1-sided p < 0.050' and theta_1 > 0. State the one-sided p-value rule and effect direction separately; a p-value is not an upper confidence bound.
source_b_wording: One-sided permutation p < 0.05. H_0,1: theta_1 <= 0 vs H_1,1: theta_1 > 0.
methodological_impact: Conflating p-values with upper confidence bounds creates ambiguity in statistical reporting and risks misinterpretation by peer reviewers.
recommended_resolution: State the decision rule strictly: 'Reject H_0,1 if one-sided paired permutation p < 0.05 and observed point estimate theta_hat_1 > 0. Report point estimate, standard error, and two-sided 95% cluster-bootstrap CI alongside the exact p-value.'

source_a_wording: v2.1 summary describes Gate 2 as E2 vs E1 emergency-recall preservation. Earlier design included E2 vs E3 benign B-FER non-inferiority.
source_b_wording: Endpoint: Benign False Emergency Rate (B-FER) on N = 350 Benign Background Clips. Estimand: theta_2 = E[B-FER_E2 - B-FER_E3]. Null: H_0,2: theta_2 >= delta_B (E2 degrades B-FER). Comparator is E3.
methodological_impact: Comparing E2 to E1 evaluates the unprincipled addition of 212 samples against baseline. Comparing E2 to E3 isolates the data selection policy under strictly matched N=634. Dropping benign B-FER eliminates the critical safety check against excessive false alarms.
recommended_resolution: Confirm Gate 2 evaluates Benign B-FER non-inferiority with E3 as comparator on N=350 benign clips. Rejecting H_0,2 requires upper 95% bootstrap bound < delta_B = 0.020.

source_a_wording: Gates 2 and 3 are described as paired non-inferiority McNemar tests. Ordinary pooled McNemar targets paired binary correctness/micro recall. Four-class macro-recall requires a class-aware method.
source_b_wording: Endpoint: Emergency Macro-Recall (Rec_macro) on N = 700 Emergency Targets (175 per class). Estimand: theta_3 = Rec_macro_E3 - Rec_macro_E2. Test: Inversion of 10,000 class-stratified cluster-bootstrap bound (Upper 95% < delta_R = 0.025). Comparator is E3.
methodological_impact: Pooled McNemar computes micro-recall across all emergency instances, allowing dominant or acoustically easy classes (sirens) to mask catastrophic recall collapse on rare/difficult classes (screams). Unweighted macro-recall treats all 4 emergency classes equally but is a ratio metric invalid for McNemar.
recommended_resolution: Retain 4-class macro-recall as the Gate 3 endpoint. Formally reject McNemar for Gate 3; mandate class-stratified cluster-bootstrap inversion (Upper 95% bound < delta_R). Comparator is E3.

source_a_wording: Macro-recall and macro-F1 require recomputing the full confusion matrix and metric in each class-stratified recording-cluster bootstrap replicate.
source_b_wording: Full Benchmark 5-Class Macro-F1 Superiority (N = 1,400). Estimand: Delta Macro-F1 = Macro-F1_E2 - Macro-F1_E3. Test: Class-stratified cluster bootstrap. Decision rule: Lower 95% bootstrap bound > 0.000. Degenerate rule: If TP_c + FP_c = 0, P_c = 0.0, F1_c = 0.0.
methodological_impact: Macro-F1 is a harmonic mean of ratios. Resampling without degenerate handling causes zero-division if a model abandons a class, while simple averaging of per-sample F1 scores is mathematically undefined.
recommended_resolution: Confirm Gate 4 tests 5-class Macro-F1 superiority using 10,000 class-stratified cluster-bootstrap draws with the full 5x5 confusion matrix recomputed per draw and explicit penalization (F1_c = 0) for abandoned classes.

source_a_wording: Emergency recall preservation is described using delta_B = 0.020. delta_B previously denoted the benign-background margin. Endpoint and margin naming must agree. Are delta_B = 0.020 and delta_R = 0.025 defensible operational margins?
source_b_wording: Gate 2 (Benign B-FER): delta_B = 0.020 (2.0%). Gate 3 (Emergency Macro-Recall): delta_R = 0.025 (2.5%).
methodological_impact: Symbol conflation creates fatal ambiguity in preregistration. Furthermore, margins must be defended based on operational nuisance dispatch tolerance and clinical/industrial safety rather than statistical convenience.
recommended_resolution: Strictly decouple symbols: delta_B = 0.020 (2.0% maximum excess benign false alarms) and delta_R = 0.025 (2.5% maximum allowable emergency macro-recall degradation). Require advisor sign-off on both numerical margins.

source_a_wording: Add an equivalence margin so a null result is interpretable (smallest effect of interest, e.g. a stated pp difference in A-FER, justified operationally). Turns 'not significant' into 'smaller than X'.
source_b_wording: Specifies one-sided superiority only (H_0,1: theta_1 <= 0 vs H_1,1: theta_1 > 0). No equivalence margin or two one-sided test (TOST) defined.
methodological_impact: If Gate 1 fails to reach p < 0.05, superiority testing yields an uninformative null ('absence of evidence is not evidence of absence'). The paper cannot claim that model-error guidance has negligible benefit without a pre-registered equivalence margin.
recommended_resolution: Pre-register an equivalence bound (Smallest Effect of Interest, SESOI) of Delta_equiv = 0.030 (3.0 pp A-FER difference). If Gate 1 fails superiority, evaluate TOST against [-0.030, +0.030] to establish statistical equivalence.

source_a_wording: Gates 2 and 3 are described as paired non-inferiority McNemar tests... Ordinary pooled McNemar targets paired binary correctness/micro recall.
source_b_wording: Gate 1: Paired sign-flip permutation (R=100,000). Gate 2: Inversion of 10,000 cluster-bootstrap percentile bound. Gate 3: Inversion of 10,000 class-stratified cluster-bootstrap bound. Gate 4: Class-stratified bootstrap (B=10,000).
methodological_impact: Applying McNemar to macro-recall or macro-F1 is mathematically invalid. Bootstrap inversion is the valid non-parametric method for bounded ratio inference in clustered paired designs.
recommended_resolution: Reaffirm Protocol v2.1 test specifications. Formally purge all remaining references to McNemar for Gates 2, 3, and 4 from all project text. McNemar is strictly reserved for the exploratory binary ensemble estimand theta_2.

source_a_wording: Pre-specify that all four gate estimates and CIs are always reported, even after a failed gate. Fixed-sequence ordering governs which claims may be made, not which numbers are shown.
source_b_wording: If any gate fails to reject, testing halts immediately, and no subsequent confirmatory claims are permitted. Stopping Rule: Halt trial if p >= 0.05.
methodological_impact: Halting testing without reporting downstream metrics creates severe publication bias and conceals informative safety and recall outcomes from the scientific record.
recommended_resolution: Clarify that the fixed-sequence gatekeeper governs formal confirmatory rejection decisions only. Pre-specify that point estimates, standard errors, and 95% CIs for ALL 4 gates will be fully calculated and published in the benchmark results table regardless of earlier gate outcomes.

source_a_wording: Power results are simulations conditional on assumed effect sizes and discordance patterns, not observed Phase 3 performance or guarantees. Specify estimand, discordance assumptions, simulation model, and test.
source_b_wording: Pooled Gatekeeper sequence (Gates 1 to 4) is fully powered (>99%). Paired Sign-Flip Permutation (alpha = 0.05, Power > 99%).
methodological_impact: Unqualified claims of >99% power misrepresent conditional simulations as empirical certainties. In reality, power drops to 89.9% at Delta=0.05 and 52.4% at Delta=0.03, and simulations only covered Gate 1, not Gates 2, 3, or 4.
recommended_resolution: Update protocol text to state: 'Statistical power is simulated as 99.8% conditional on an assumed true effect Delta >= 0.08, discordance p_disc = 0.25, and cluster correlation rho = 0.65. If the unexposed true effect shrinks to Delta = 0.05, power is 89.9%.' Acknowledge that Gates 2-4 power was not simulated.

source_a_wording: Physical recordings are the independent sampling units. Three seed predictions on one recording are repeated outcomes, not three independent recordings.
source_b_wording: Unit of Analysis: Physical recording cluster. Permutation and bootstrap sampling resample recording clusters.
methodological_impact: Consensus exists between brief and protocol, but historical Phase 1 and 2 scripts occasionally treated windowed clips or multi-seed predictions as independent degrees of freedom, inflating test statistics.
recommended_resolution: Enforce cluster-level grouping by canonical physical recording ID (recording_id) across all evaluation scripts. Forbid treating 10s audio slices from the same original recording as independent sample units.

source_a_wording: Confirm the unusually low E3 seed variation was investigated and documented... seeds are repeated measures within a recording.
source_b_wording: Exactly three identical seeds (42, 123, 2026) across all arms. Primary estimand averages seed predictions (theta_1). Secondary estimand evaluates majority-vote probability ensemble (theta_2).
methodological_impact: In Phase 1 in-distribution evaluation, E3 achieved identical accuracy across all 3 seeds (.9143), raising questions about DataLoader seed isolation. Furthermore, confusing ensemble deployment with single-model expected performance muddles the active scientific claim.
recommended_resolution: Document the Phase 1 E3 zero-variance investigation. Formally distinguish the primary estimand (expected performance of a single trained model: theta_1) from the secondary deployment estimand (3-model ensemble: theta_2).

dimension: Test Set v3 composition and blinding
source_a_wording: Balanced controlled benchmark (N=1,400); not real-world prevalence. Proposed 2,400-candidate quota assumes an estimated 30% rejection rate during quality review.
source_b_wording: N = 1,400 total (700 emergency targets, 350 benign controls, 350 targeted confusers). Two-Key cryptographic blinding (Key A + Key B) with sealed container execution.
methodological_impact: The balanced benchmark isolates sensitivity and specificity, but cannot evaluate real-world false alarm frequency (MTBFA). A pure balanced benchmark would leave reviewers questioning operational validity in continuous monitoring.
recommended_resolution: Confirm N=1,400 balanced composition for primary confirmatory testing, paired with a mandatory pre-registered 72-hour continuous streaming simulation (24 injected events) for operational deployment validation.

source_a_wording: BBC Sound Effects are excluded... Freesound licences vary by recording (CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-NC)... What release format is acceptable: audio, metadata-only, or tiered release?
source_b_wording: 5-Tier release policy: Tier 1 Audio (CC0/CC-BY/CC-BY-NC); Tier 2 Annotations (CC0); Tier 3 Manifests (CC0); Tier 4 Evaluation Code (MIT); Tier 5 Model Predictions (CC0). Permanent exclusion of BBC audio.
methodological_impact: Redistributing raw audio under mixed CC licenses on Zenodo creates legal exposure if CC-BY-NC files are redistributed in commercial settings or if attributions are missing. Metadata-only release is legally safe but increases researcher friction.
recommended_resolution: Present both options to advisor: Option 1 (Full 5-tier open benchmark release on Zenodo with machine-readable CC attribution manifest) vs Option 2 (Metadata-only release on Zenodo with automated Freesound download script). Recommend Option 1.
